messages:
maya: hey team :wave: i'm Maya, started today. quick q — i'm setting up for a Private deployment and need VPC/network access + service credentials. who owns service access and VPC config? also, who do i page for infra-oncall vs eng-sre for incidents? thanks!

onboarding-bot: welcome @maya! For new hires see the onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboard.

Run the quick access request: `./scripts/request_access --resource vpc --env private --user maya` or open a ticket in #help-access. If you need immediate oncall help, see rota below.

alex: eng-infra owns the VPC/network and private deployment setup. ping @eng-infra for config changes and subnet/VPN stuff. For access provisioning open a ticket in infra-access (Jira) with the template — include team, env, and service name.

sam: eng-sre owns SLOs, runbooks, and pager response. Pager rules: page `eng-sre-oncall` for service outages and `infra-ops` for cluster/capacity issues. If it's a perf/regression -> page eng-sre first, they’ll triage and cc infra if needed.

jamie: product note — if this is for a rollout or feature flag testing, loop in product-ops after infra has finished setup so we can coordinate canary windows.

devops-rotations: FYI the oncall schedule: eng-sre primary is weekdays 9am-5pm PST, nights/weekends handled by eng-sre-backup. To page use `/pager eng-sre-oncall <short reason>` or call +1-555-0102 for urgent.

maya: perfect, thanks! one more: who signs off on Dedicated capacity / billing access? want to make sure my team can view usage dashboards and set budgets.

alex: billing access is shared infra+finance. Request `billing-read` via the identity portal (https://id.redwood.internal) and include cost-center. For provisioning Dedicated capacity admin escalate to infra-leads (i'll DM who to include).

maya: i'll open the infra-access ticket now and include the cost-center. thanks all :thumbsup: feel free to DM if I missed anything.
